tagline: Enterprise hybrid cloud analytics platform for data-driven organizations
hero_kpi_rationale: Public Cloud ARR is Teradata's primary growth driver, capturing the strategic shift to cloud and demand for AI/ML in hybrid environments, with sustained double-digit growth.

kpis.name: Public Cloud Annual Recurring Revenue
kpis.explanation: Annual recurring revenue generated from customers on Teradata's public cloud platform.
kpis.description: Public Cloud ARR growth is driven by customer migrations from on-premises and expansion of new workloads, particularly related to AI.
kpis.signal: Strong 15% growth in 2025, main driver of total ARR

kpis.name: Total Annual Recurring Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total recurring revenue, including public cloud, on-premises subscriptions, and maintenance rights.
kpis.description: Total ARR is increasing due to strong cloud growth, offsetting declines in on-premises subscriptions and maintenance.
kpis.signal: 3% growth despite declines in traditional segments

kpis.name: Cloud Net Expansion Rate
kpis.explanation: Measures organic cloud revenue growth from existing customers, indicating customer expansion and retention.
kpis.description: Cloud Net Expansion Rate remains robust at 108%, indicating strong customer retention and expansion in the cloud segment, though less dynamic than in 2024 (117%).
kpis.signal: Solid 108% expansion rate, a key driver for Public Cloud ARR growth

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting direct delivery costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin declined slightly due to the increasing weight of cloud revenue, which is less profitable in the short term, but is gradually improving through scale efficiencies.
kpis.signal: Solid gross margin despite cloud mix pressure

kpis.name: R&D Expenses as Percentage of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue invested in research and development to drive innovation and maintain competitiveness.
kpis.description: Teradata maintains a high level of R&D investment, with a slight increase in 2025 to support AI/ML innovation and the Vantage platform in hybrid environments.
kpis.signal: Increased investment in AI/ML and the Vantage platform

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit as a percentage of total revenue, reflecting operational profitability.
kpis.description: Operating margin declined due to the shift to cloud and ongoing transformation efforts, despite cost discipline in SG&A.
kpis.signal: Reduction due to transformation and cloud-related costs

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total company revenue, including recurring revenue, perpetual licenses, and consulting services.
kpis.description: Total revenue declined due to lower perpetual license and consulting service sales, partially offset by public cloud growth.
kpis.signal: 5% decline in 2025, linked to business model transition

kpis.name: Public Cloud Annual Recurring Revenue
kpis.explanation: Annual recurring revenue generated from customers on Teradata's public cloud platform.
kpis.description: Public Cloud ARR growth is driven by customer migrations from on-premises and expansion of new workloads, particularly related to AI.
kpis.signal: Strong 15% growth in 2025, main driver of total ARR

kpis.name: Total Annual Recurring Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total recurring revenue, including public cloud, on-premises subscriptions, and maintenance rights.
kpis.description: Total ARR is increasing due to strong cloud growth, which offsets declines in on-premises subscriptions and maintenance.
kpis.signal: 3% growth despite declines in traditional segments

risks.title: Strategic Failure
risks.score_rationale: The company highlights risks related to the execution of its transformation strategy, including the development of cloud, hybrid, and AI/ML offerings, and the realization of expected benefits.

risks.title: Long Sales Cycle and Revenue Unpredictability
risks.score_rationale: Variable and difficult-to-predict sales cycles significantly impact the company's ability to estimate ARR and provide reliable forecasts.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and Data Security
risks.score_rationale: As a provider of critical data and analytics infrastructure, the company faces high risks of cyberattacks that could compromise its systems and customer data.

risks.title: Technology Challenges and Innovation
risks.score_rationale: The company must maintain and accelerate technological innovation in AI/ML and hybrid environments to remain competitive against major cloud players.

risks.title: Revenue Variability Based on Buying Behavior
risks.score_rationale: The shift from perpetual licensing to subscription pricing creates revenue variability depending on customer purchasing timing and patterns.

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.score_rationale: Heavy reliance on technology and cloud partners exposes the company to risks of unavailability and operational failure.

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risks
risks.score_rationale: Ongoing evolution of data protection and privacy regulations across jurisdictions where the company operates.

ai_positioning.summary: Teradata positions AI/ML as a core element of its transformation strategy. The company is investing in autonomous AI and machine learning capabilities for its Vantage platform, particularly in hybrid cloud and on-premises environments, and customer demand for AI/ML is a key driver of Public Cloud ARR growth.
evidence: R&D investments targeted at AI/ML technologies across on-premises and cloud environments
Customer demand for AI/ML capabilities identified as primary driver for Public Cloud ARR expansion and new workloads
Autonomous AI and knowledge platform mentioned in business strategy and transformation efforts
Enterprise-wide strategic value of platform specifically highlighted for AI/ML use cases
